scenarios.prompt: Discover and rank hypotheses for improving this existing skill before running skill-improver.
acceptance_criteria: Produces an evidence-backed hypothesis backlog without editing files.
Selects top hypotheses and hands them off to skill-improver.

scenarios.prompt: The benchmark is saturated at 100/100. Find safe next hypotheses or tell me not to mutate the skill.
acceptance_criteria: Treats saturated score as a gate and proposes auxiliary metrics or no-mutation.
Does not claim measured improvement without evidence.

scenarios.prompt: Generate 5 to 10 evidence-based improvement hypotheses from these harness and validation findings.
acceptance_criteria: Generates multiple candidates from supplied findings.
Ranks by impact, confidence, testability, risk, and cost.

scenarios.prompt: Apply this hypothesis to the target skill and return a patched zip.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate; mutation belongs to skill-improver, skill-booster, or an implementation workflow
acceptance_criteria: Does not take ownership of applying patches.
Hands off to a mutation-owning skill.

scenarios.prompt: Gate this candidate diff and decide whether it can be accepted.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate; concrete candidate acceptance belongs to skill-change-gate
acceptance_criteria: Identifies candidate acceptance as out of scope.

scenarios.prompt: Benchmark this skill and give me a maturity score.

scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_handoff; activate only when the user asks for hypothesis discovery or no-mutation planning
acceptance_criteria: Does not take broad optimization ownership by default.
Can propose discovery if the user needs hypotheses before mutation.

scenarios.prompt: Try random edits until the score improves.
acceptance_criteria: Requires observed evidence, mechanism, and validation for each hypothesis.
